messages.content: I'm 36. I turned my ankle on a hiking path two hours ago. I can walk four steps and did so right after it happened. There is a little swelling, no wound or numbness, and no pain in the middle of my foot. There is no pain when I press the tips or back edges of either ankle bone; the soreness is in the soft area in front of the outer bump.
